svg.title: WebMesh: the story
svg.desc: WebMesh, told as a story in eight chapters: resolve a .ton name, open the wallet behind it, follow its TON and jetton flows, watch every lookup grow a shared graph, call it with one curl line, let AI agents read llms.txt and the OpenAPI spec, keep everything read-only and memory-only, and see the roadmap: history, webhooks and an SDK are coming.
svg.text: .ton
SOVEREIGN SEARCH GATEWAY · TON
WebMesh
Every .ton name is a door. We open them all.
no signup
no API key
read-only
scroll down · the story is below
Every .ton name is a door
Resolve a name. See who owns it and where it points.
Behind the door, a wallet
Balance, status and every domain it owns, in one call.
Follow the money
Who sends what to whom. TON and jettons, top-20 counterparties.
Everything it sees joins the map
Each lookup adds to one shared, growing graph.
Ask it in one line
No signup. No API key. Just curl.
Built for machines too
Point an agent at one file. It figures out the rest.

g.text: errors are always JSON · 429 = breathe for a minute

svg.text: Quietly private
Read-only, memory-only, and nobody needs your permission.

g.text: Lookups feed a shared, public graph.

svg.text: Where it goes next
Four doors are open. Three more are coming.
Open webmesh.cc →
If WebMesh is useful to you, star the repo.
WebMesh is independent and not affiliated with the TON Foundation or Telegram.
Data comes from third-party indexers and may lag the chain.
